verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Companies House runs a real REST API (probe-1) with a developer-specs site carrying Authorisation, Rate limiting and API versioning guides. None of the cited items mentions a published OpenAPI/Swagger spec, XML schemas or a data dictionary. Human-readable guides and a live API are adjacent to the story, not the machine-readable specification it asks for.

support.subject: As a developer, a machine-readable specification for the service's machine channel is published — an OpenAPI spec, XML schemas, or a data dictionary
